Class StandardEventFormatter

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.AbstractStandardEventFormatter
io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.StandardEventFormatter
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogFormatter, LogFormatter.EventFormatter
public final class StandardEventFormatter extends AbstractStandardEventFormatter
A TTLL formatter that has the layout of TTLL - Time, Thread, Level, Logger but allows changing the format of time, thread, level, logger, etc.
